description: This file provides a Python wrapper for the mcumgr command-line tool, including classes for handling images and exceptions, and methods for managing device images such as upload, list, test, and confirm.

classes.name: MCUmgr
classes.description: A wrapper class for the mcumgr command-line tool, providing methods to interact with device images and manage device state.

classes.name: MCUmgrException
classes.description: Custom exception class for mcumgr-related errors.

classes.name: MCUmgrImage
classes.description: Data class representing an image with attributes like image number, slot, version, flags, and hash.

methods.name: create_for_serial
methods.description: Creates an MCUmgr instance configured for serial connection.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if the mcumgr tool is available on the system.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a command using the mcumgr tool and returns its output.

methods.name: image_upload
methods.description: Uploads an image to the device, optionally specifying a slot and timeout.

methods.name: get_image_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of images from the device.

methods.name: _parse_image_list
methods.description: Parses the output of 'image list' command into MCUmgrImage objects.

methods.name: get_hash_to_test
methods.description: Returns the hash of the image to be tested (not active).

methods.name: get_hash_to_confirm
methods.description: Returns the hash of the image to be confirmed (not confirmed).

methods.name: image_test
methods.description: Runs a test on the specified image hash.
